task: Make CLI OTLP analytics send a normalized parent/current repository identifier instead of the full cwd when a git repo has no remote origin (EPMCDME-15937).

key_reasoning.reason: Open design decisions: which field carries the fallback (repo_remote overloaded vs a new repository field), and whether raw cwd must stop being sent to satisfy the no-username/home-exposure criterion. The latter may need backend coordination.

The closest pattern is resolveRepositoryName/extractRepository, which gives parent/current. It does not cover the privacy aspect: a cwd directly under home yields username/dir, and raw cwd still reaches the backend. That gap is treated as a divergence. The AC also lists cross-OS path cases with no adapter-level test template for them. The change sits in the shared OtlpAgentAdapter base class, which affects all adapters.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped to L: the existing fallback helper does not cover the security-sensitive aspect (username/home exposure, raw cwd still sent)
Component Scope kept at M: touches the shared OtlpAgentAdapter base class used by all OTLP adapters
